content.value_statement: Email and password auth needs careful verification, reset, and hashing choices. This skill gives Better Auth teams practical setup patterns with security-focused defaults.
actual_capabilities: Shows how to enable Better Auth email and password authentication.
Explains email verification callbacks and required verification behavior.
Provides password reset flow examples for server and client calls.
Covers reset token lifetime and session revocation settings.
Demonstrates password length rules and custom Argon2id hashing.
limitations: It does not provide a complete email delivery service implementation.
It does not validate application-specific redirect allowlists.
It does not migrate existing password hashes automatically.
It depends on Better Auth APIs matching the documented version.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up Email Login
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new Better Auth project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me enable Better Auth email and password login with email verification. Include the key settings I need to configure.

prompt_templates.title: Add Password Reset
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through adding a Better Auth password reset flow with reset email delivery and a safe redirect URL.

prompt_templates.title: Harden Existing Auth
prompt_templates.scenario: Security review of an existing configuration.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Better Auth email and password setup for verification, token expiry, session revocation, and password length gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Hash Migration
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced migration from default hashing to a custom algorithm.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a Better Auth password hashing migration to Argon2id without locking out existing users.

output_examples.input: I need email verification before users can sign in.
output_examples.output: Enable the email verification sender, require email verification for password sign-ins, and test that unverified users receive a new verification email.

output_examples.input: I need a safer password reset flow.
output_examples.output: Configure the reset email sender, use an absolute reset URL, shorten token expiry when appropriate, and revoke sessions after reset.
Keep scrypt for the default path or add a tested Argon2id implementation. Plan migration before changing algorithms for existing users.

best_practices: Require email verification before allowing password sign-in for sensitive applications.
Use absolute callback and reset URLs that match approved application origins.
Revoke active sessions after password reset to reduce account takeover risk.
anti_patterns: Do not log password reset tokens, reset URLs, or unnecessary account identifiers.
Do not change password hashing algorithms without a migration plan.
Do not rely only on client-side validation for password policy enforcement.

faq.question: Does this skill configure email delivery for me?
faq.answer: No. It shows where to connect your email sending function inside Better Auth.

faq.question: Can users sign in before verifying email?
faq.answer: They can unless you enable the setting that requires email verification for password sign-ins.

faq.question: Are reset tokens reusable?
faq.answer: No. The skill states that reset tokens are single-use and expire by default.

faq.question: Should I use absolute redirect URLs?
faq.answer: Yes. Absolute URLs avoid origin inference problems across separate frontend and backend domains.

faq.question: Does this support Argon2id?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes an example for custom hash and verify functions using Argon2id.

faq.question: Can this migrate old password hashes?
faq.answer: No. It warns that changing algorithms requires a migration strategy.
